title: Min edge filter accepts values the select can't show (0.5, 1, 4, 10, 25)
expected: Select shows the active min edge, or the value is snapped to an option.
actual: parseEdgeFilters accepts any 0 < min <= 25, the select has only Any/2/3/5/8. The filter is applied (e.g. min=25 gives '0 of 1') while the select shows 'Any'. Values >25 or <=0 or junk are silently treated as no filter (min=99999, -5, abc, 25.01), which is acceptable but undisclosed. Repeated params (sport=nba&sport=cbb, min=2&min=8) are ignored and fall back to defaults; unknown sport, XSS strings in sport/book are not reflected (no XSS seen), all return 200.
evidence: tickets/evidence/EFP-003.png; node fetch of the URLs listed
suspected_area: packages/db/src/feed.ts parseEdgeFilters vs MIN_EDGES in edges/page.tsx
